title: Emergency Department Triage and Resuscitation
content:
SOP: Emergency Department Triage and Resuscitation (SOP-EMG-001)
DEPARTMENT: Emergency Department
VERSION: 3.0
ROLES: doctor, nurse, triage_officer
PURPOSE: Categorize arrivals into ESI Levels 1 to 5 and direct to resuscitation bay.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Emergency Department Triage and Resuscitation in full compliance with Emergency Department hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Emergency Department Triage and Resuscitation in full compliance with Emergency Department hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Emergency Department Triage and Resuscitation in full compliance with Emergency Department hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Emergency Department Triage and Resuscitation in full compliance with Emergency Department hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Emergency Department Triage and Resuscitation in full compliance with Emergency Department hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of Emergency Department Triage and Resuscitation in full compliance with Emergency Department hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Emergency Department.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-EMG-001 Emergency Department Triage and Resuscitation v3.0, Section 4
